paragraphs: In [Rosh Hashanah 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.31a.9-10) he reported in the name of Rav; Hyman says that the name there should be Rav Chanan bar Rava.[^1][^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Anan bar Rava speaking in Rav’s name about the Temple reading. In the next paragraph, Rav Chanan bar Rava reports in Rav’s name that the same divisions apply in the synagogue. Hyman proposes Chanan in the notice, and [Heilprin’s Chanan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1407&lang=en) cites his report on this folio.
